method.label: The LegitBodyFix method
method.intro: The plan follows a simple sequence: understand the movement first, restore useful options, rebuild capacity, then carry the result into the activity that matters.

steps.title: Assess
steps.description: Observe the movement you notice, identify the relevant body area, and establish a useful baseline.

steps.title: Restore
steps.description: Explore comfortable range, breathing, and control before adding more demand.

steps.title: Rebuild
steps.description: Use a focused progression to develop strength, coordination, and capacity.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Recheck the original movement and carry the new options into training or daily life.

library.label: Inside the library
library.intro: Train by body area, follow a reset from start to finish, and return whenever your movement needs attention.

knowledge.label: Free movement guides
knowledge.intro: Learn what may influence a movement pattern, then find the guided program that fits your goal.

standard.quote: The goal is not to chase perfect posture. It is to build a body that has options.

customSections.title: START WITH WHAT YOU ACTUALLY NOTICE.
customSections.body: Choose the movement problem that feels familiar. You do not need to know the diagnosis or the exact muscle before you begin.

items.title: My hips feel blocked in a squat
items.body: Start with hip, ankle, and squat movement checks.

items.title: My back feels stiff after hinging
items.body: Explore comfortable trunk, hip, and hinge options.

items.title: Overhead movement feels restricted
items.body: Check shoulder, scapular, and thoracic contributors.

items.title: I want to return to training confidently
items.body: Use a focused progression instead of collecting random drills.

items.title: Is this medical treatment?
items.body: No. LegitBodyFix provides educational movement content, not diagnosis or medical treatment. If you have a recent injury, worsening symptoms, numbness, weakness, or significant pain, seek qualified clinical care.

items.title: How do I choose a session?
items.body: Start with the movement or body area that feels most relevant. Each session page explains its goal, level, duration, equipment, and who it is designed for before you purchase.

items.title: Is there a subscription?
items.body: No. Individual sessions use one-time pricing. There is no recurring membership charge.

items.title: How do I access a purchase?
items.body: Your purchase is connected to your checkout email. Sign in with that email to open the protected session in My library.
